items.body:
Thanks for the detailed analysis. The report describes a possible deadlock, but it does not include a runnable example that reproduces it, so we cannot confirm the lock ordering from the description alone. Please add a minimal script that uses `Live(..., redirect_stdout=True, redirect_stderr=True, auto_refresh=True)` and triggers concurrent printing or logging from another thread or task. The Rich version and platform are already listed. If you can, also paste the output of `python -m rich.diagnose`.

Related earlier reports you may want to read: #927 (deadlock when exiting `Status`) and #3125 (redirected output with `Live`). Questions about how to use Rich belong in [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions).

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
